input: Find summer programs and camps specifically for teens and middle schoolers for kids and teens in Madison, Yancey, Mitchell, McDowell and Rutherford counties, NC, and Johnson City, TN. Look past the big, well-known camps: search with varied wording and town names and list every organization you find.
searches: 2026 teen summer camp Madison county Mars Hill Marshall

candidates.name: Corylace Cove
candidates.note: 2026 Craft Guild camps offered knife making and metalsmithing for ages 11–16.

candidates.name: Madison County Community Learning Centers
candidates.note: 2026 K–8 summer camps included wilderness survival, outdoor theater, STEAM and farm-to-table cooking.

candidates.name: Madison County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2025 Summer Fun offered local educational day camps for ages 5–18, including teens.

candidates.name: Mars Hill University
candidates.note: 2026 offerings included sports camps, Summer Music Camp and residential marching band camp for grades 8–12.

candidates.name: Glory Ridge
candidates.note: Christian youth-group summer camp; official site documents summer 2026 camp weeks.

candidates.name: Yancey County Schools
candidates.note: Free CTE career-exploration camps ran in 2025 and 2026; 2025 eligibility was rising grades 7–10.

candidates.name: Partners Aligned Toward Health (PATH)
candidates.note: Summer offerings include Toe River Racqueteers tennis/pickleball camps and Youth to Youth Summer Experience.

candidates.name: Mitchell County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2026 4-H Summer Fun educational camps; individual camp descriptions and eligibility available from the county office.

candidates.name: Penland School of Craft
candidates.note: Summer programming includes kids’ art camps and separate teen craft workshops.

candidates.name: Camp Spring Creek
candidates.note: Residential summer camp for ages 7–15 with dyslexia and language-based learning differences; 2026 sessions documented.

candidates.name: McDowell County Schools
candidates.note: Camp Opportunity ran June 15–18, 2026 for middle schoolers; also offers Academy for Innovation Summer Bridge.

candidates.name: Camp Grier
candidates.note: Day and overnight summer programs include older-youth adventure, specialty and leadership-training camps.

candidates.name: Camp Timberlake
candidates.note: Boys’ Christian sleepaway summer camp; official site documents the completed 2026 summer.

candidates.name: Rutherford County 4-H / N.C. Cooperative Extension
candidates.note: 2025 and 2026 Summer Fun offered educational workshops, tours and hands-on activities for ages 5–18.

candidates.name: Piedmont Council, Scouting America
candidates.note: Runs Scouts BSA summer camp at Camp Bud Schiele; summer 2027 registration announced.

candidates.name: Rutherford County Visual Artists Guild
candidates.note: Summer Art Exploration camps for teens ages 12+ were listed for July 2025 at its Main Street studio.

candidates.name: East Tennessee State University
candidates.note: Teen offerings include Applied STEM grades 8–12, bluegrass ages 12–19, medical/pharmacy camps and sports camps.

candidates.name: Johnson City Parks and Recreation
candidates.note: 2026 summer camps included Jump Start JC for ages 6–12, accommodating younger middle schoolers.

candidates.name: Providence Academy
candidates.note: 2026 community-open summer camps in athletics, fine arts and discovery; eligibility varies by rising grade.
